_readme: Gamification rules (SRS v2.3 §3.8). All numbers are content, not code: change them here without touching components.

quizPass.note: A stop is completed when every question has been answered correctly; the stamp is 'gold' when at least 4 of 5 were right on the first try, 'silver' otherwise. Retries are unlimited; there is no fail screen (GD-5).

ranks.title: Bachiller
ranks.meaning: Bachelor of Arts, as Rizal became in 1877

ranks.title: Ilustrado
ranks.meaning: An educated Filipino of the reform generation

achievements.title: Sobresaliente
achievements.desc: Answer all five questions of a stop right on the first try.

achievements.title: Emperor of the class
achievements.desc: Reach a streak of 10 correct answers.

achievements.title: Detective
achievements.desc: Find 10 mistakes in 'spot the error' questions.

achievements.title: Timekeeper
achievements.desc: Put 10 sets of events in the right order.

achievements.title: Globetrotter
achievements.desc: Complete a stop in all four regions.

achievements.title: Bookworm
achievements.desc: Open 'Read more' and the sources on 10 stops.

achievements.title: Builder of Dapitan
achievements.desc: Build the school, clinic and water system.

achievements.title: Polyglot
achievements.desc: Read a stop in both English and Filipino.

achievements.title: The journey goes on
achievements.desc: Reach the end of Rizal's journey.
